sources.license: Upstream terms; no blanket open-source license published
sources.notes: The db/ folder of the pinned revision holds 676 per-title .psv packs for the FinalCheat/VitaCheat plugins. No LICENSE file is published in the upstream repository, so this catalog keeps the original pack bytes untouched and records the exact commit, per-file source URL and author header of every pack. Attribution stays with the original code authors listed in each pack.
